passed_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS IAM policy does not allow assume role permission across all services
code_block:
LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub order-processor-exec-role-${AWS::StackName}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: order-processor-sqs-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SQSPollAndAcknowledge
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: order-processor

passed_checks.check_name: Ensure Lambda Runtime is not deprecated
code_block:
OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: order-processor
      Description: Processes order events from SQS with robust, secure defaults.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: !Ref ReservedConcurrentExecutions
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Environment:
        Variables:
          QUEUE_URL: !Ref OrderQueue
          QUEUE_ARN: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref CodeS3Bucket
        S3Key: !Ref CodeS3Key
        S3ObjectVersion: !If [HasCodeS3ObjectVersion, !Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, !Ref "AWS::NoValue"]
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: order-processor
    DependsOn:
      - OrderProcessorLogGroup
